savePolicy: One explicit tool-returned path per job. SHA256-identical original copy, per-job immutable provenance, no image-input references, no latest-file discovery.
transformPolicy: Preserve raw original bytes. Remove only wholly transparent right/bottom padding, retain left/top transparency, then aspect-preserving right/bottom anchored fit to exact assetSize and alpha-preserving WebP.
dispatchPolicy: Pilot first. Call image_gen independently once per job using callArguments. Keep per-job result paths and timestamps; no shared mutable progress file.
